about.title: About {app}
about.body:
{app} v{version}

Non-Steam game installer, prefix migrator, save validator, and artwork manager for SteamOS & Linux.

License: MIT License
Author: Murilo Giatti
Repository: github.com/murilogiatti/DeckInstall

Translations live in locales/*.json. English is the primary language.
